text: He will make your righteousness [your pursuit of right standing with God] like the light, And your judgment like [the shining of] the noonday [sun].
But the humble will [at last] inherit the land And will delight themselves in abundant prosperity and peace.
The sword [of the ungodly] will enter their own heart, And their bow will be broken.
For those blessed by God will [at last] inherit the land, But those cursed by Him will be cut off.
All day long he is gracious and lends, And his descendants are a blessing.
Wait for and expect the LORD and keep His way, And He will exalt you to inherit the land; [In the end] when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
The LORD helps them and rescues them; He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, Because they take refuge in Him.
